  "memo": "R01 holds because the established account had a recent password reset and recently linked device. Account access is the only adverse family; no other rule holds, no household exception is needed, and no earlier outcome settles the order. A legitimate device replacement with a password reset is the strongest benign explanation. Under §6.6(b), contact was the sole required check. It passed, so §5.3(a) now requires clear and prohibits further hold, decline, escalation or needs_check. The order remains unshipped. No additional check is needed."
